title: Companies House can annotate the Register of Overseas Entities
summary: Since 30 June 2025, Companies House can add notes to the Register of Overseas Entities. This includes where a person who verified an entity's information does not show that they are AML-supervised when asked.
what_changes: The registrar may note on the register where an overseas entity appears to have been dissolved, wound up or otherwise ceased to exist.
The registrar may note where a person has not fully complied with an information notice under section 1092A of the Companies Act 2006.
The registrar may note where a verifying agent does not reply in time to a request to show that a supervisory authority supervises them.
who_it_applies_to: Firms that verify information for overseas entities on the Register of Overseas Entities, and firms acting for those entities.

history.event: Regulations made on 2 June 2025 and in force from 30 June 2025.
